# Jingyue Glass (Wuhan Jingyueda Household Products Co., Ltd.) - Full Machine-Readable Knowledge Base

> Website: https://www.jingyueglass.com/
> Entity: Wuhan Jingyueda Household Products Co., Ltd. (Jingyue Glass)
> Business Type: Direct Factory Glassware Manufacturer & Exporter (B2B / OEM / ODM / Private Label)
> Primary Manufacturing: Machine-blown crystal stemware, machine-pressed beer mugs, high-borosilicate glassware, and bespoke wooden/rigid presentation gift packaging.
> Harmonized System (HS) Codes: 7013.37.0000 (Commercial Drinking Glasses, other than glass-ceramics / lead crystal), 7013.99.0000 (Decanters & Tableware), 4420.90.9000 (Wooden Presentation Boxes).

---

## 1. Commercial Pricing & Quotation Policy (B2B Policy)
- **No Fixed Public Pricing:** As a factory-direct OEM/ODM manufacturer, Jingyue Glass does not publish fixed public consumer prices because commercial quotations depend on:
  1. Total Order Quantity and batch production allocations;
  2. Selected Model, Capacity, and Glass Composition (Lead-Free Crystal / High-Borosilicate / Soda-Lime);
  3. Custom Branding and Decoration Technique (Laser Engraving, 580°C Kiln-Fired Ceramic Decal, Gold Rim, Spray Coating);
  4. Packaging Specification (5-ply Export Master Carton with Dividers vs Custom Wooden Presentation Box with Odorless EPE Pearl Cotton Insert vs Individual Mailer Box);
  5. Incoterms & Destination Port (FOB Wuhan/Shanghai, CIF, DDP Air Express or Ocean Freight).
- **Fast RFQ Response:** Itemized formal commercial quotations are provided within 1 business hour upon receipt of project specifications.
- **Physical Sampling:** Standard sample dispatch is available for verified buyers; custom decorated sample proofing terms are confirmed in the project brief.

---

---

## 4. International Regulatory Compliance & Certified Test Reports
- **US California Proposition 65:** Verified **PASS** by STQ Testing Services Co., Ltd. (Official Test Report Reference: **SZ2025091217-4E**). Extractable lead and cadmium test via AOAC 16th Ed. Section 973.32 conforms to California settlement limits (Pb < 0.05 mg/L, Cd < 0.01 mg/L).
- **US FDA Food Contact Safety:** 100% compliant with FDA Compliance Policy Guides CPG 7117.06 (Cadmium) and CPG 7117.07 (Lead) for food and beverage contact surfaces.
- **European Union LFGB & EC 1935/2004:** Non-detectable heavy metal release and food contact safety certified according to German LFGB Section 30/31 and Framework Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004.
- **Phytosanitary ISPM 15:** Solid pine wooden presentation boxes undergo certified heat treatment and carry compliant IPPC stamps for global customs entry.
